title: SocialScience InterviewThematicAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Completed scenario 05a. Implemented reproducible preprocessing + quantitative descriptives (outputs/processed_interviews.csv, descriptives.json, term frequency tables, weighted log-odds distinguishing terms), generated 2 figures (report/images/word_count_by_cohort.png; report/images/distinguishing_terms_logodds.png), implemented Anthropic Messages API thematic-analysis script (model claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) that saves full response to outputs/anthropic_messages_response.json and parsed JSON to outputs/thematic_analysis_parsed.json, and wrote the publication-style report to report/report.md (also copied to interview_thematic_report.md). Key quantitative finding: N=24 (12 per cohort) with similar response lengths; lexical differences show transit_primary emphasizes transit-specific infrastructure/scheduling terms (e.g., train/transit/station/bus/stop), while car_primary emphasizes driving/traffic/parking-related terms.
